text.p: France international Laurent Blanc will leave Barcelona to play for former European champions Marseille next season, club sources said on Thursday.

They said the 31-year-old defender, capped 61 times and a key figure in France's 1998 World Cup plans, would join Marseille on a three-year contract for 13 million francs ($2.2 million), but they did not say when he was expected to sign.

With Blanc and Le Havre defender Teddy Bertin, who was expected to sign later on Thursday, Marseille have taken to 10 the total of recruits for the new French season, including new coach Rolland Courbis.

Blanc, French footballer of the year after helping Auxerre to the 1996 league title before joining Barcelona, began his career at nearby Montpellier, making his first division debut in 1987. He has also played for Napoli, Nimes and St Etienne.
